praise.label: Hail them: "Chairman! Odogwu! Money miss road!"

block.label: Stand in front of the car. No shaking.

madam.name: Madam in a jeep
hints: A jeep slows. Gold bangles on the steering wheel, gospel music loud.
A woman in lace tells her driver to slow down and looks at you like a project.

oga.name: Big oga
hints: A black saloon. The window comes down one inch. Cigar smoke.
A man in a white kaftan steps out to buy suya. Three phones.

bigBoy.name: Young big boy
hints: A loud yellow sports car, Afrobeats shaking the gate. He's filming himself.
A young man with a chain bigger than his neck, live on social media.

pastor.name: Pastor in a Prado
hints: A Prado with a sticker: "Blessed and Highly Favoured". The man inside is praying.
A man in a suit with a big Bible on the dashboard.

security.name: Estate security
hints: A man in a reflective vest walks out of the gate with a whistle and a long stick.
Estate security. He has been watching you for a while.

nephew.name: Young man in FEP agbada
hints: A young man in brand-new FEP agbada. Two police escorts behind his car. A rice bag with a familiar face on the back seat.

bassey.name: Man in plain clothes
hints: A big man in a plain shirt buying akara. His boots are Task Force boots. He looks very tired and very off duty.

fake.label: Look busy. Film yourself for Settlement.

events.text: A TV camera swings towards you.
The crowd starts singing your chant.
Rival thugs push through the crowd towards you.
The mic goes dead. Everybody looks around.
A police van parks by the Roundabout.
